prompt: We just decided to use PostgreSQL as our primary database instead of MongoDB for our new SaaS product. We picked Postgres because the team knows it well, it gives us ACID transactions which we need for billing, and it's cheaper to run on AWS RDS than MongoDB Atlas. MongoDB was tempting for its flexible schema but we figured we'd rather have schema discipline. Write an ADR for this.

assertions.description: File has YAML frontmatter with title, adr, status, date, authors, and changelog fields
Document contains Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options, and Decision sections
Each option (PostgreSQL and MongoDB) lists pros and cons referencing the same named decision drivers
Document includes a Consequences section with at least one good and one bad consequence
ADR file is at docs/adrs/NNNN-*.md with zero-padded number and kebab-case name
docs/adrs/README.md exists and contains a table entry linking to the new ADR
